title: Purple Sector: choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Marshal Post. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Marshal Post
options.lineage: trackside marshalling: flag signals, kerbs, tarmac
options.thesis: The app signals like a marshal post: one flag colour, readable from a moving car.
options.viewport: Feed of followed drivers' laps; each card leads with a big tabular lap time over a kerb strip whose blocks are the sector colours.
options.risk: Kerb stripes become decoration if used anywhere but sector progress.

raised.raise: Every comparison graph registers on one shared distance axis at a fixed scale.
On the comparison screen the delta line owns the field; everything else recedes.
All times set on a strict tabular-numeral grid so digits never shift.
Map pins sized by how many drivers have posted on the route.

options.label: Timing Tower
options.lineage: F1 broadcast timing tower and live-timing screens
options.thesis: Every list is a timing tower: ranked rows, sector cells, nothing else.
options.viewport: Feed as a tower of rows: position, driver, lap time, three sector cells.
options.risk: Familiar: this is where most motorsport apps land.

options.label: Split-Flap Board
options.thesis: Leaderboards as a departure board: times flip in character by character.
options.viewport: Feed rows in fixed character cells; new posts clack in at the top.
options.case: Strong for leaderboards and the new-post moment; drivers don't see their world in a train station.
options.risk: Reads as a novelty if the flip runs on every update.

options.label: Grid Specimen
options.thesis: Lap times built cell by cell on a visible grid.
options.viewport: Huge grid-built lap time over a faint construction grid.
options.case: A poster, not a tool you read at the pit wall.
options.risk: White ground glares in a car.
options.kept: Strict tabular-numeral grid for every time.

options.label: Catalog Sleeve
options.thesis: Every lap a catalog entry, one plot owning the field.
options.viewport: A white line stack of the delta trace on black.
options.case: Coded labels slow down people reading in a hurry.
options.kept: One plot owns the comparison screen.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.thesis: Laps as registered plates at the same scale.
options.viewport: Laps aligned on a shared baseline.
options.case: Cream and engraving have nothing to do with a paddock.
options.kept: Registered comparison at one fixed scale.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Routes as stars, ranked by magnitude.
options.viewport: Navy map with routes as sized dots.
options.case: Beautiful for the map, foreign to every other screen.
options.kept: Dot size encodes how busy a route is.

options.label: Design Annual
options.thesis: Each lap a plate with registration marks.
options.viewport: Near-white sheet with hairline-ruled lap plates.
options.case: A gallery register; drivers need a working dashboard.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A fitness-tracker feed: white cards, one orange accent, map thumbnails.
canonCard.viewport: Activity cards with avatar, map, stats row, kudos.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every sports tracker; glares in a car.
